hints.title: Generating 2020 Calendar Months
hints.text: Generate a recursive sequence for months 1 to 12 representing the calendar year 2020.

hints.title: Active Drivers Cumulative Count
hints.text: For month m, count all drivers whose join_date is on or before the last day of month m in 2020.

hints.title: Accepted Rides Monthly Count
hints.text: Count all accepted rides whose requested_at falls within month m of 2020.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH RECURSIVE Months AS (
    SELECT 1 AS month
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month + 1 FROM Months WHERE month < 12
)
SELECT m.month,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Drivers d WHERE d.join_date <= LAST_DAY(CONCAT('2020-', LPAD(m.month, 2, '0'), '-01'))) AS active_drivers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AcceptedRides ar JOIN Rides r ON ar.ride_id = r.ride_id WHERE YEAR(r.requested_at) = 2020 AND MONTH(r.requested_at) = m.month) AS accepted_rides
FROM Months m
ORDER BY m.month;
```

complexity.notes: Iterates through 12 calendar buckets computing cumulative driver availability and ride volume.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Missing months with zero active drivers or zero rides are dropped without a full calendar sequence.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursive month series guarantees all 12 calendar buckets are represented.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recursive CTE calendar generation combined with date range aggregation.

WITH RECURSIVE Months AS (
    SELECT 1 AS month
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month + 1 FROM Months WHERE month < 12
)
SELECT m.month,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Drivers d WHERE d.join_date <= (TO_DATE(CONCAT('2020-', LPAD(CAST(m.month AS TEXT), 2, '0'), '-01'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::date) AS active_drivers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AcceptedRides ar JOIN Rides r ON ar.ride_id = r.ride_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.requested_at) = 2020 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.requested_at) = m.month) AS accepted_rides
FROM Months m
ORDER BY m.month;

import pandas as pd

def hopper_company_queries_i(drivers: pd.DataFrame, rides: pd.DataFrame, accepted_rides: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    months_df = pd.DataFrame({'month': list(range(1, 13))})
    drivers['join_date'] = pd.to_datetime(drivers['join_date'])
    rides['requested_at'] = pd.to_datetime(rides['requested_at'])
    merged_rides = rides.merge(accepted_rides, on='ride_id')
    rides_2020 = merged_rides[merged_rides['requested_at'].dt.year == 2020].copy()
    rides_2020['month'] = rides_2020['requested_at'].dt.month
    rides_count = rides_2020.groupby('month').size().to_dict()
    active_list = []
    rides_list = []
    for m in range(1, 13):
        end_of_month = pd.Period(f'2020-{m:02d}', 'M').end_time.date()
        act = len(drivers[drivers['join_date'].dt.date <= end_of_month])
        active_list.append(act)
        rides_list.append(rides_count.get(m, 0))
    months_df['active_drivers'] = active_list
    months_df['accepted_rides'] = rides_list
    return months_df
